decision: NO family flips engines. Receiving yards alone passing non-inferiority does not justify splitting the receiving stack across two engines while receptions stays on the champion (coherence would DECREASE). The joint engine remains PRIVATE RESEARCH: its per-draw coherence and correlation structure are proven (joint-game-sim.test.mjs) and it now provides the only internally consistent scenario generator for research — but published forecasts stay on the evaluated marginal engines, and their architecture label stays 'independently calibrated marginal heads over one shared game environment', which is what they are.
whatWasLearned: Coherence and predictive quality are different properties, measured separately — the coherent model lost to independent calibrated baselines on 4 of 5 bars, exactly the charter's warning.

The TD quality gap localizes the next candidate: the calibrated TD engine's grid-selected shrink/flatten does real work that raw share allocation discards; a joint TD mechanism must inherit that calibration, not re-derive shares.

Gross-passing = receiving reconciliation is structurally sound (per-draw invariants hold at 6000 draws) — the passing family's problem remains the CENTER (rolling4 still wins), unchanged from P248's diagnosis.
Identical-points discipline caught two population bugs before they could flatter the candidate (legacy conditioning; emission-set differences).
evidentiaryStatus: 2025 reused throughout (P247 annex); 2026 forward record decides. The joint engine may re-candidate with a calibrated TD mechanism and a repaired passing center under a fresh preregistration.
